description: SERVER-ROUND16-PREREGISTRATION.md, the first plan of two (the local pilot estimate is about 39 h, more than 20 h for one plan; the rule "Rules"): S0, then 1bk on splits 81-85 (configs/gomea/phase1bk-a: the full spec and the three manifests with splits 81-85 only; the budget round: BASE-TLS, TLS-RV and TLS-RVL at 20,000 and at 100,000 evaluations per run, no time limit; 7 datasets (Air, Con, Dow, EnC, EnH, Tow, Yac); 210 MOSES runs; an interim report on these 210 runs). Three manifests: sr.json (the 20,000 arms, 5,120 MB), sr-100K.json (the 100,000 arms, 8,192 MB, after the local pilot: gate item 3) and sr-Dow.json (all 6 arms on Dow, 8,192 MB); sr-100K.json and sr-Dow.json get a W of their own. One phase, no Boolean phase. No extension, no choice step, no adoption rule. 1bk needs splits 81-90 of the 7 datasets (setup.sh builds them). Then round16b runs the other 210 runs (splits 86-90) and the report on all 420.
